sections.title: Image-Based Anatomy
sections.description: Taught by a radiation oncologist, this course covers major organ systems and disease areas and is presented from a radiologic or imaging (including cross-sectional) viewpoint in addition to a standard anatomy and physiology presentation.  Students complete anatomical contouring assignments on the Varian Eclipse treatment planning system, applying anatomical knowledge in a clinically realistic environment. Additionally, students have the opportunity to participate in a Virtual Reality Lab using Human Anatomy VR software for interactive learning. By the end of this course, students will be able to identify and describe major anatomical structures across organ systems using radiologic and cross-sectional imaging as well as perform basic anatomical contouring using Varian ARIA as part of image-guided treatment planning workflows.  Fundamental knowledge of anatomy and physiology is recommended.
